root_cause_criterion.criterion: Before `exec()` may call `search(reg, data_pattern, data_pattern_end, ...)` on the separate truncated copy, that buffer must satisfy `onigenc_is_valid_mbc_string(enc, data_pattern, data_pattern_end) != 0`.
root_cause_criterion.description: The vulnerable original reaches the first `data_pattern` search with `data_pattern_valid=0` and still executes `data_pattern_search`, which is the missing source-level validation obligation for the copied GB18030 buffer. The fixed original skips that search when the same invalid original witness keeps `data_pattern_valid=0`, and the closest one-byte boundary perturbation (`tail byte 0xf2 -> 0x36`) turns the predicate true while the fixed binary still executes the protected search event.
root_cause_criterion.verification_note: In the frozen assertion traces, the vulnerable original violates the predicate at `data_pattern_guard` (`0 == 1`) while triggering `data_pattern_search`; the fixed original is guarded (`0 == 1` with no protected event), and `perturbation_tail_byte_36` is the genuine fixed-side witness (`1 == 1` with `data_pattern_search` executed).

nodes.state: The copied search buffer carries a distinguished terminal byte at `*(data_pattern_end - 1)`. On the vulnerable original that byte is the truncated `0xf2` tail copied into the 80-byte `data_pattern` object; on the perturbation witness the same terminal position carries `0x36`.
At the decisive word-break decode, `p + 1` equals the searched buffer end pointer, so `onigenc_wb_is_break_position()` is decoding the final byte of `data_pattern`.

At the ASan sink, the byte at `p` is classified as a GB18030 `CM` lead byte. That classification makes `gb18030_mbc_enc_len()` increment `p` and perform the second-byte map read that overruns the one-byte tail condition proved upstream.

edges.relation: The exact terminal byte copied into `data_pattern` is the same byte later decoded by the word-break helper as `*p`.
The same `data_pattern_end` pointer that bounds the root search reappears as `p + 1` in the word-break helper, proving that the helper is decoding the last byte of the searched buffer.
The same final-byte pointer selected by `onigenc_wb_is_break_position()` is passed unchanged into `gb18030_mbc_enc_len()` as the lead-byte pointer.
